offering_description.value: NCR Voyix sells checkout and store operations software to retailers and restaurants. It delivers cloud and on-site systems for point of sale, self-checkout and digital ordering, with implementation, maintenance and payment processing services.

primary_products.value: retail point-of-sale software; restaurant point-of-sale software; self-checkout software; store and inventory management software; digital ordering software

primary_services.value: systems implementation and integration; managed IT services; field maintenance and repair; payment processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Supermarkets, general merchandise retailers, convenience and fuel retailers, restaurant chains and independent restaurants

end_markets.value: grocery retail; general merchandise retail; convenience and fuel retail; quick-service restaurants; full-service restaurants

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to point-of-sale and commerce software; licensing or royalties: Licenses for on-site retail and restaurant software; service fees: Managed IT, field maintenance and technical support contracts; project or contract: Implementation, integration and rollout of checkout systems; transaction or usage fees: Merchant payment processing
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees; project or contract; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Integrates catalog, order and payment data into commerce software for retailers and restaurants; service provider: Deploys and maintains checkout systems and processes payments for retailers and restaurants

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Retail checkout and store operations, restaurant ordering and management, merchant payments and technology services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving retail and restaurant chains; partners / resellers: Technology resellers and implementation partners serving retailers and restaurants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Payment card handling and customer data are subject to PCI DSS and privacy laws such as GDPR.

notes: The current scope of checkout hardware sold directly by NCR Voyix is uncertain.
